scripts.short: Hello there! Every frame of this short clip was generated on a local computer. The voice is synthetic, and so is the face. Thanks for watching.
scripts.long: Good morning, and welcome to a quick look at a local talking head test. Everything you are watching was made on one desktop computer, without any cloud service. The portrait was generated from a text description, so this person does not exist, and this voice comes from an open text to speech model. The video model only sees the picture and the sound, and it tries to move the lips, the jaw, and the head in time with the speech. Please judge the mouth movements for yourself, especially at the start and at the very end. Goodbye!

speech.note: Synthetic speech from scripts written for this test; not a recording or clone of a real person's voice.
